scripts.prepare-assets: npm run prepare-showcase && npm run prepare-voiceover
scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts CairnReusableApiExplainer out/stills/frame-1200.png --frame=1200
scripts.still:problem: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts CairnReusableApiExplainer out/stills/frame-300.png --frame=300
scripts.still:solution: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts CairnReusableApiExplainer out/stills/frame-1500.png --frame=1500
scripts.still:showcase: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts CairnReusableApiExplainer out/stills/frame-1950.png --frame=1950
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts CairnReusableApiExplainer out/cairn-reusable-api-explainer-silent.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted --concurrency=3 --timeout=120000
scripts.render:voiceover: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts CairnReusableApiExplainer out/cairn-reusable-api-explainer-voiceover.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --concurrency=3 --timeout=120000
